::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022 by Manish Srivastava. Raised $2M seed funding from Bluehill Capital shortly after securing a ~$1.2M (₹10 crore) DLI grant from MeitY. R&D and product-design centre based in Udupi.
:::

## What does this firm design?

A multi-vital biosensing SoC consolidating ECG, PPG, respiration, and temperature monitoring into a single ultra-low-power chip for compact, energy-efficient medical wearables.
